# Press Release
## Completion of the Initial Critical Operations Phase of the Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) Spacecraft
October 21, 2026 (JST)

Today, on October 21, the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) confirmed that the critical sequence during the initial operations of the Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) spacecraft, which launched on October 20, was successfully completed and that the spacecraft is in good health.
